question: Should Neuralwatt ship with separate prepaid-credit and subscription-kWh quota surfaces, or is balance-only presentation an intentional supported contract even when an active subscription remains usable?
rationale: The official API exposes two independently usable pools with different units and reset behavior; choosing which one defines provider availability and the primary menu state is a product decision rather than a mechanical parser fix.

options.title: Show both quota pools
options.body: Add a subscription kWh window alongside prepaid USD credits so active subscription capacity cannot be mistaken for account exhaustion.

options.title: Accept balance-only semantics
options.body: Keep the smaller UI but explicitly define prepaid credits as the only supported metric and avoid status wording that implies the whole account is unusable.

recommendation.title: Show both quota pools
recommendation.body: Add a subscription kWh window alongside prepaid USD credits so active subscription capacity cannot be mistaken for account exhaustion.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the branch hardening and already framed this exact product choice in the related Neuralwatt audit.
